segments.name: Packaged bakery foods
products: snack items (bars, cakes, cookies, and crackers)
segments.description: Produces and markets packaged bakery foods such as breads, buns, rolls, snacks, bagels, tortillas and baking mixes for U.S. retail and foodservice customers.
segments.evidence: Our principal products include breads, buns, rolls, snack items (bars, cakes, cookies, and crackers), bagels, English muffins, tortillas, and baking mixes and are sold under a variety of brand names, including Nature's Own, Dave's Killer Bread ("DKB"), Canyon Bakehouse, Simple Mills, Wonder, and Tastykake.

revenueModel.text: Sells branded retail and other bakery products to mass merchandisers, supermarkets, retailers, restaurants, foodservice distributors and institutions, and operates thrift outlets.
revenueModel.evidence: Fresh baked foods' customers include mass merchandisers, supermarkets and other retailers, restaurants, quick-serve chains, food wholesalers, institutions, dollar stores, and vending companies.

changes.text: In Fiscal 2025 the company moved from one operating segment to two operating segments, legacy Flowers Foods and Simple Mills, which it aggregates as one reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Concurrent with the acquisition of Simple Mills, the company has identified two operating segments based on how business activities are managed and evaluated, legacy Flowers Foods and Simple Mills.

changes.text: In February 2025 the company acquired Simple Mills, adding its crackers, cookies, snack bars and baking mixes to the portfolio.
changes.evidence: On February 21, 2025, the company completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity interests of Purposeful Foods Holdings, Inc., the parent company of Simple Mills, Inc.
